## Daily AI Digest
**What it does:** Every morning at 7 AM, pulls the latest AI news from top RSS feeds, takes the 8 freshest stories, builds a clean HTML digest, and emails it to you.

**Setup (one-time):**
1. In n8n: connect your Gmail account on the Send Digest node (click -> Select Credential -> Create New -> sign in with Google)
2. Put your email address in the Config node (`recipientEmail`)
3. Activate the workflow. You will get the digest every morning.

nodes.name: Config
nodes.notes: Put your email here to receive the digest.

nodes.name: Merge Feeds
nodes.notes: Combines both feeds into one list.

nodes.name: Top Stories
nodes.notes: Keeps only the freshest N stories (N from Config).

nodes.name: Build Digest
nodes.notes: Turns the stories into a clean, mobile-friendly HTML email.
